data.reason_zh: 以可复用外部技能为对象，用验证集性能与能力差距诊断驱动技能进化，并保留快照供后续轮次及跨骨干复用。

scope_support.feedback_quote: Skill-Library Snapshot Selection uses performance on a fixed validation set disjoint from execution tasks to select an effective historical snapshot for subsequent evolution
scope_support.object_quote: Representing these operations and strategies as reusable external skills allows them to be refined through self-evolution without updating model parameters.
scope_support.persistence_quote: skills can be improved using experience from different data settings and directly reused across backbones
